outputs.explanation: Panel A includes a bar graph (mean ± SD) of HMGB1 signal intensity in nucleus/cytoplasm across genotypes. Only bars with error bars are shown; no individual data points (e.g., dots for each of the >100 cells/4 mice) are overlaid.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart (mean ± SD, N=4 mice, n>400 cells) showing % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a western blot image only, not a plot of averaged data, so this check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot showing time on rotarod over weeks with error bars. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E consists of line plots (time on rotarod across days at 5w, 9w, 21w) with error bars. Line plots are exempt from this check.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot, which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G shows only histological micrograph images, no plot of averaged data.
Panel H contains two bar graphs (mean ± SD, N=3 mice, n=9 fields) for molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, but no individual data points are shown overlaid on the bars.
